description: Source code for a helper module that adds command-line interface (CLI) commands and handles interactions with Google Sheets API, including appending and reading spreadsheet data.

classes.name: SheetsHelper
classes.description: Helper class implementing CLI commands for Google Sheets operations.

methods.name: inject_commands
methods.description: Adds '+append' and '+read' subcommands to CLI command parser.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles execution of append and read commands, making API calls accordingly.

methods.name: build_append_request
methods.description: Constructs API request parameters and body for appending data to a spreadsheet.

methods.name: build_read_request
methods.description: Constructs API request parameters for reading data from a spreadsheet.

methods.name: parse_append_args
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments for the '+append' command into configuration.

methods.name: parse_read_args
methods.description: Parses CLI arguments for the '+read' command into configuration.
